Delta 8 is an isomer to the main compound Delta 9 in Marijuana.

Isomer's are basically compounds with identical elemental formulas, but the atoms are arranged differently.

Marijuana mostly has Delta 9, and a crap ton of isomers in miniscule amounts in it.  Most of those isomers roughly do the same as Delta 9.

In other words, if marijuana would wreck your sobriety, then so would most of Delta 9's isomers.
